_comments._source: Combat data rows consumed by game/src/combat (docs/02 §1.5, §1.6, §1.9). Announce lines are the CIVIS compliance VO (§1.9 quirk 3: they announce everything, honestly). Spawn weights are the §1.6 composition ramp — composition, not HP sponging, is the primary difficulty lever; tier4 mixes leaders + dual ranged.
_comments.announce: Machine telegraph VO. Tone per 01-vision controversy contract: the comedy is the bots' literal-mindedness, never anyone's fear.
_comments.spawnWeights: Relative weights per rep tier (human) and for the machine family. Encounter guarantees (ranged by encounter 2, bruiser by 3, leader at tier 4, >=1 scanner in machine fights) are enforced in code on top of these weights.
